21] On perusal of the aforesaid judgement of the Supreme Court, it clearly reveals that when the fair value of the land acquired under the Act of 1894 cannot be ascertained, the Court is required to assess the value by applying the method of annual increase in the value of the property either at the flat or cumulatively rate.
